stages.title: Hardware
stages.blurb: A repair bench, a local network, and other people's broken machines. Boards, drivers, backups, permissions. The habit of hunting a fault starts here.

stages.title: Code
stages.blurb: PHP and MySQL, then interfaces built from other people's mockups. Thirteen sites shipped across a CMS agency and a Shopify studio.

stages.title: AR & 3D
stages.blurb: A point-of-sale running on a Raspberry Pi, and an augmented reality application for exploring laboratory projects. Its long-term aim was guiding technical work without an instructor present.

stages.title: Quality
stages.blurb: Automotive fasteners, then cable manufacturing. In-process and final inspection against drawings, defects traced back to their cause, then a team to lead.

stages.title: NDT
stages.blurb: Ultrasonic, magnetic particle, penetrant, visual and radiographic. Reading what the surface will not show you, then writing it down so somebody else can rely on it.

stages.title: Oil & Gas
stages.blurb: Pipelines, flowlines and gas trains. Six projects supported from inside an ISO/IEC 17020 inspection environment.

stages.title: Documentation
stages.blurb: Procedures written and revised, technician competency tracked, calibration recorded, everything traceable. The software background, finally pointed at the inspection floor.
